name: City Council Meeting Agenda -Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MAY 8, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
 through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
 open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting, or
 may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
 4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
 see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83092891902
  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of April 24, 2024 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  City to Schools Program - White Oak Elementary School 4th Grade Students
  – Student Councilmembers and City Manager

2.  Recognition and Appreciation - California Highway Patrol – Captain Denis
  Ford, Officer Clayton Phillips and Public Information Officer Casey
  Ramstead

3.  Presentation of the City of Westlake Village 2024 Citizen and Youth of the
  Year Awards
  • Tish Matthews – 2024 Citizen of the Year
  • Isabella Ordonez – 2024 Youth of the Year

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.
 COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

RECESS:

Recess for White Oak Elementary Students departure. Refreshments served outside.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 84-001, MODIFICATION NO. 2;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2343-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2343-24, determining
  Conditional Use Permit No. 84-001, Modification No. 2 is exempt from CEQA and
  approving Modification No. 2 of CUP No. 84-001 to authorize an expansion of the
  hours of operation for an existing car wash and gas station located at 30909
  Thousand Oaks Boulevard.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2343-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 2 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 84-001 TO AUTHORIZE AN EXPANSION OF THE HOURS OF
  OPERATION FOR AN EXISTING CAR WASH AND GAS STATION LOCATED AT 30909
  THOUSAND OAKS BOULEVARD

2.  OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 24-001; CONSIDERATION OF CEQA
  DETERMINATION AND RESOLUTION NO. 2344-24 - Adopt Resolution No.
  2344-24, determining Oak Tree Permit No. 24-001 is exempt from CEQA and
  approving Oak Tree Permit No. 24-001 to authorize the removal of four protected
  oak trees and the pruning of one protected oak tree located at 147 Sherwood Drive.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2344-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 24-001,
  AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF FOUR PROTECTED OAK TREES AND THE
  PRUNING OF ONE PROTECTED OAK TREE LOCATED AT 147 SHERWOOD DRIVE

3.  FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025 ASSESSMENTS FOR LIGHTING AND LANDSCAPE
  ASSESSMENT DISTRICTS: RESOLUTION NOS. 2345-24, 2346-24 AND 2347-
  24 - Adopt Resolution Nos. 2345-24, 2346-24, and 2347-24 to levy the
  assessments for Fiscal Year 2024-25 within the Lighting Maintenance District No.
  1, Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 and Westlake Spectrum Landscape
  District No. 15; and that the City Clerk and City Engineer be directed to file a
  certified copy of the Resolutions, annual assessments and diagrams with the Los
  Angeles County Auditor-Controller.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2345-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE CONFIRMING A DIAGRAM AND ASSESSMENT FOR THE 2024-25
  FISCAL YEAR, AND ORDERING THE IMPROVEMENTS IN CONNECTION WITH CITY OF
   WESTLAKE VILLAGE LIGHTING MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT NO. 1 PURSUANT
  TO THE PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF DIVISION 15 OF THE STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE

  RESOLUTION NO. 2346-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE CONFIRMING A DIAGRAM AND ASSESSMENT FOR THE 2024-25
  FISCAL YEAR, AND ORDERING THE IMPROVEMENTS IN CONNECTION WITH WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT NO. 1 PURSUANT TO THE
  PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF DIVISION 15 OF THE STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE

  RESOLUTION NO. 2347-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE CONFIRMING A DIAGRAM AND ASSESSMENT FOR THE
  2024-25 FISCAL YEAR, AND ORDERING THE IMPROVEMENTS IN CONNECTION
  WITH WESTLAKE SPECTRUM LOCAL LANDSCAPE ASSESSMENT DISTRICT NO. 15
  PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF DIVISION 15 OF THE STREETS
  AND HIGHWAYS CODE

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective May 1, 2024 in the amount of
  $1,686,213.28

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

1.  ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 (SENATE BILL 1)
  PROJECT LIST; RESOLUTION NO. 2348-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2348-24,
  identifying the FY 2024-25 Annual Street Improvement Project to utilize the Road
  Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account Funds.

  RESOLUTIONS NO. 2348-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE IDENTIFYING THE FY 2024-25 ANNUAL STREET
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECT TO UTILIZE ROAD MAINTENANCE AND REHABILITATION
  ACCOUNT FUNDS

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVAL OF THE SECURITY SYSTEM CAMERA PURCHASE AGREEMENT
  AND CAMERA SYSTEM USE POLICY; RESOLUTION NO. 2349-24 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2349-24 adopting the Security Camera System Use Policy; and
  approve the purchase and installation agreement with Aid Alert to install security
  cameras at the Civic Center and authorize the Mayor to sign the contract on behalf
  of the City.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2349-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING A SECURITY CAMERA SYSTEM USE POLICY
 NEW BUSINESS:

1.  AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO STREET SWEEPING CONTRACT WITH
  CLEANSTREET - Approve Amendment No. 1 to the citywide Street Sweeping
  contract with CleanStreet and authorize the Mayor to sign the contract amendment
  on behalf of the City.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, May 2, 2024 at 2:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  May 2, 2024

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
